title: ScienceLabPlan/v1
description: A deterministic execution plan produced by the planner (WP-B14) from a ScienceLabRunRequest + the router's decisions. A plan is a DAG of steps (each a capability profile engaged for the claim) with typed selection states, resource estimates, and dependency edges. The plan carries the policy_hash and catalog_hash it was built against so a re-plan after either changes is detectable. A plan is NOT evidence: grants_authority is pinned to false, and a step SELECTED means the capability applies and an adapter is available, NOT that the capability ran or that the claim is supported. Canonical JSON contract: sorted keys, compact separators, UTF-8, no NaN/Infinity, trailing newline.

plan_id.description: Content-addressed identity: sha256 over the canonical encoding of the plan (without this field), prefixed 'sha256:'. Computed by srl.planning.planner.plan_id.

request_id.description: The request_id of the ScienceLabRunRequest/v1 this plan satisfies. The plan is a deterministic function of (request, claim, catalog, policy); the same inputs yield a byte-identical plan.

plan_digest.description: A sha256 digest over the canonical encoding of the plan WITHOUT plan_id and without this field (i.e. over the plan's content: steps, hashes, created_utc). Distinct from plan_id: plan_id is the identity over the WHOLE plan (including plan_digest), while plan_digest is the content digest an executor can recompute to verify the plan body was not tampered with after the id was minted.

steps.description: The ordered DAG of plan steps, in topological order (a step appears after every step it depends_on). Each step names a capability profile, its selection state (SELECTED / EXCLUDED_TYPED / NOT_APPLICABLE / WAIT_CAPABILITY), the adapter it would use (or null), its dependencies, and a resource estimate. The planner admits the SUMMED resource estimates against the request's resource_class caps.

step_id.description: A stable step identifier within the plan: '<profile>' for single-instance profiles, or '<profile>:<index>' for multi-instance profiles (e.g. a model_composition over several components). Referenced by depends_on.

profile.description: The capability profile this step engages. One of the 15 capability profiles.

capability_id.description: The catalog capability identifier for this profile (e.g. 'cap.geometry_tda'). For a profile with no catalog entry, this is the synthesized id 'cap.<profile>'.

adapter_id.description: The logical adapter identifier the step would run on (e.g. 'ripser'), or null if no adapter is available (WAIT_CAPABILITY). A REMOTE_REQUIRED profile never falls back to a local adapter: absence of a local adapter yields WAIT_CAPABILITY, never a fake local substitute.

depends_on.description: The step_ids this step depends on (its inputs come from their outputs). The planner orders steps topologically; a cycle raises CONTRACT_INVALID. Empty for a root step.

selection.description: The typed selection state: SELECTED (the profile applies AND an adapter is available, so the step will run), EXCLUDED_TYPED (the request or classifier explicitly excluded this profile, with a reason), NOT_APPLICABLE (the profile does not apply to this claim), WAIT_CAPABILITY (the profile applies but no adapter is available yet, or the capability is unknown/future/remote_required — an honest wait, never a silent fallback).

exclusion_reason.description: A typed reason string when selection=EXCLUDED_TYPED (e.g. 'not_requested', 'classifier_excluded'), or null otherwise. REQUIRED non-null when selection=EXCLUDED_TYPED; REQUIRED null otherwise.

resource_estimate.description: The estimated resource footprint of running this step: wall_seconds (CPU/wall time), rss_bytes (resident set size), scratch_bytes (scratch disk). Non-negative integers. For a non-SELECTED step, these are the estimate as if it WERE selected (so an executor can budget a future WAIT_CAPABILITY step); the planner sums only the SELECTED steps' estimates against the caps.

allOf.$comment: exclusion_reason is REQUIRED non-null iff selection=EXCLUDED_TYPED; REQUIRED null otherwise. A SELECTED/WAIT_CAPABILITY/NOT_APPLICABLE step with a non-null exclusion_reason is a contract violation.
A SELECTED step MUST carry a non-null adapter_id (a selected step runs on a real adapter). A WAIT_CAPABILITY/NOT_APPLICABLE/EXCLUDED_TYPED step has a null adapter_id (no adapter is engaged).

policy_hash.description: The sha256 digest of the canonical encoding of the AdmissionPolicy the plan was admitted against. A change in policy (e.g. tightened caps) changes this hash, so a stored plan's policy_hash lets an executor detect a stale plan.

catalog_hash.description: The sha256 digest of the canonical encoding of the capability catalog the plan was built against (catalog_digest). A change in catalog (e.g. an adapter became available) changes this hash.

created_utc.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp at seconds precision (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ). No offset, no fractional seconds.

canonical_writes.description: Safety const: a plan is immutable once authored. Always 0; a non-zero value is a contract violation.

grants_authority.description: Safety const: a plan never grants authority on its own. Always false; a true value is a contract violation. A plan is a schedule, not evidence; SELECTED means 'will run', not 'the claim is supported'.
